svg.title: Technical Flight Officer gray epaulet sleeve
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"rank-epaulet-sleeve-gray-technical-flight-officer","name":"Technical Flight Officer gray epaulet sleeve","size_in":{"w":1.966,"h":3.843},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,196.6,384.3],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-1 / A5-6 give no inch size. Scale 178 px per inch from the 1 in oak leaf on the Major sleeve in Fig A5-1; trapezoid (350 px bottom, 306 px top, 684 px tall at that scale) and all feature positions measured on the figure. Officer sleeves come in two sizes (standard / smaller); the figure shows no measurable difference, so one size is built. Cloth colours (the truth for every view of the sleeve): gray #5f5c5c, cadet-officer blue #142347, from assets/epaulet-sleeve-colours.js; the edge-on strips on the Class B shirt/blouse, aviator shirts and Class A coat sheets use the same two values (they were #6e6a69 / #072157). Flight Officer sleeves, measured on the vendor pictures (sleeve length = 100 %): CAP capitals FO 18.4-31.6 %, TFO 15.7-26.9 %, SFO 20.0-30.9 % from the top edge, word 0.90 / 1.01 / 0.98 in wide; white lace stripes 5.3 % (0.20 in) thick, the lowest one ending 10.7 % (FO), 8.1 % (TFO), 8.7 % (SFO) above the hem, stripes every 12.0 % (TFO) / 11.0 % (SFO); in the three pictures the lace and the lettering are the same white (the family CAP tone is used for both).","provenance":"Fig A5-1 gave the sleeve (trapezoid, scale) and the family lettering; the lettering size and place and the lace stripes of the Flight Officer sleeves are measured on the vendor product pictures of the gray FO, TFO and SFO sleeves (reference only, nothing of them is shipped);
